matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Supervised pre-training on ImageNet classification followed by domain-specific fine-tuning on detection enables training large CNNs with limited labeled detection data.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Supervised pre-training on a large auxiliary dataset followed by domain-specific fine-tuning yields a significant performance boost when labeled training data is scarce.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: R-CNN improves mean average precision on PASCAL VOC 2010 by more than 30 percent relative to the previous best result.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: R-CNN achieves a mean average precision of 53.7% on PASCAL VOC 2010.
